Most retail listings (like on Amazon) show it as "currently unavailable" and have been for some time, with no indication of restocking or future availability. *   Boudreaux's Butt Paste
*   Desitin
*   Aquaphor Baby Healing Ointment

*   GroVia Magic Stick Organic Diaper Balm
